note: full rows of every merged climb (both sides) and every area deleted, filled or renamed; moves and re-parents are listed with their FROM so they can be reversed

routes.name: China Syndrome
routes.overview: A short 5.12 bolted line on dark, varnished stone at Atomic Energy Crag.

routes.name: Finger Fusion
routes.overview: Among the best finger jams at this crag, a sustained 5.10 crack splitting a steep wall.
routes.location: on the steep wall just right of Coyote Corner

routes.name: Mushroom Cloud
routes.overview: An obvious hand crack that ends by shuffling right along a hand rail under a large roof.
routes.crux: rightward hand traverse beneath the big roof

routes.name: Rancho Deluxe
routes.overview: A superb 5.10 corner: fingers to hands up a steep crack, then face moves past a single bolt.

areas.name: Questa Dome
areas.approach: A trail climbs steadily alongside the creek up the valley. Near the dome it runs right beside the water. Keep following the creek until you can walk easily leftward to the foot of the dome.

areas.name: Summit Crags
areas.approach: Near the summit, about 20 yards before the sign, head west toward the summit boulders and find a small gap between two boulders. Pass through it, scramble down a short chimney, then follow a faint trail down and to the right for roughly 50 yards.
